Each room reveals another part of the journey, with puzzles built around scavenged technology, broken infrastructure, old warning systems, and the strange logic of a world trying to keep itself running. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Apocalypse DLC adds 4 new escape rooms set in a near-future world devastated by an unknown catastrophe. Civilization has gone quiet. Cities are overgrown, systems are failing, and the only way forward is through the clues left by those who came before you.

Your goal is simple: survive, follow the clues, and find Sanctuary, a place rumored to still hold life.

Explore abandoned metro station, ruined gas station, desert safe house, and hidden facilities. Each room reveals another part of the journey, with puzzles built around scavenged technology, broken infrastructure, old warning systems, and the strange logic of a world trying to keep itself running.

Play solo or with friends (To play multiplayer, all party members must own this DLC), search every corner, connect the clues, and make use of what remains.

Includes

  • 4 new escape rooms set across a devastated near-future world

  • 4 new Darkest puzzles for players who want an extra challenge

  • New character outfits inspired by the apocalypse theme

The Journey to Sanctuary

57th Avenue Station
An abandoned underground station reclaimed by nature. The trains are silent, but the old systems still respond.

Auto Fuel
A deserted roadside station in the middle of nowhere. Lights still flicker, machines still hum, and someone left a way forward.

The Safe House
A lonely desert safe house with patched-together equipment, solar panels, and a signal that may lead to something bigger.

Sanctuary
A sealed underground facility built for survival. If the rumors are true, this is where the trail ends.

Follow the clues. Find Sanctuary. Escape what’s left behind...
